

```{r retrieving apoe data from loni on disk}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr params$apoe
#| results: asis

atriR:::format_quarto("APOE Data from LONI", type = "subsection")

apoe <- abcds::read_apoe(Sys.getenv("ABCDS_LONI_DATA_DIRECTORY"))

apoe %>%
  dplyr::count(allele_combo) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n = paste0(n, " (", round((n / nrow(apoe)) * 100, 2), "%)")
  ) %>%
  flextable::flextable() %>%
  atriR:::ft_add_abcds_theme() %>%
  flextable::set_header_labels(values = c("Allele Combination", "N (%)")) %>%
  flextable::width(width = 5.4 / 2)

atriR:::format_quarto(type = "newpage")

```
